MODEL: total ~ grass10 + C(Season) + Euc_canopy_cover + Distance_to_Eucalypt_canopy(m) + C(Property); Poisson family with log link; overdispersion (Poisson Pearson chi2/df = 5.15) handled via property-clustered HC1-type robust SEs rather than the likelihood. EXCLUSIONS: listwise deletion of 3 rows with missing values in modeled variables (348 of 351 rows retained; all 18 properties included; 261/351 quadrats had zero seedlings). SENSITIVITY/DECISION TRAIL: (1) NB2 GLM (alpha=5.23) on full data gave +0.071 (SE 0.163), but three properties (Olive, Rokahr, Taylor) recorded zero seedlings in every quadrat, producing separation intercepts (~-42) and sign instability; (2) NB2 excluding those all-zero properties gave -0.124 (SE 0.137); (3) Poisson clustered on the 15 informative properties gave -0.0976 (SE 0.160); (4) the reported full-data Poisson clustered fit gives -0.0976 (SE 0.1589) — all variants are small and statistically null (all |z|<1). CONCLUSION: no detectable effect of total grass cover on Eucalyptus seedling recruitment after adjusting for property, season, overhead eucalypt canopy, and distance to nearest eucalypt canopy; the conclusion is robust across family, cluster-SE, and inclusion choices.

OUTCOME: y = euc_sdlgs0_50cm + euc_sdlgs50cm_2m + euc_sdlgs>2m (total seedlings counted per 15x15 m quadrat); the precomputed euc_sdlgs_all was verified identical to this sum. MODEL: Poisson generalized linear mixed model, log link, MAP/Laplace fit (statsmodels PoissonBayesMixedGLM): y ~ grass1pp + C(Season) + canopy_c + dist_c, with a RANDOM INTERCEPT FOR PROPERTY (18 properties) — explicit random-effects handling of clustered dependence, model-based uncertainty. canopy_c and dist_c are centered Euc_canopy_cover and Distance_to_Eucalypt_canopy(m) (seed-source adjustment); Season fixed effects for the three survey rounds. RESULTS: grass1pp coefficient = -0.00991 log seedlings per 1 pp grass cover (IRR = 0.990 per pp), model-based SE = 0.00237, z = -4.18, p = 2.9e-05, 95% CI [-0.01455, -0.00526].
